items.description: Finalized optimized IR metadata names registry/ir/<FEATURE-ID>/test-plan.yaml, while the existing authoritative plans are stored at registry/test-plans/<FEATURE-ID>/test-plan.yaml.
items.preservation: Every package traces the existing registry/test-plans path and does not edit either artifact.
items.resolution: Use the resolvable authoritative test-plan path in handoff traceability; preserve the stale metadata path as an editorial ambiguity.

items.description: Authoritative source error identifiers use lowercase snake_case, but the immutable global handoff contract schema requires uppercase or CamelCase public error codes.
items.preservation: The exact source identifier is retained in each error condition and acceptance expectation; a deterministic one-to-one uppercase public alias satisfies the schema.
items.resolution: Treat the uppercase value as a transport-facing alias only; never discard or semantically rename the source identifier.

items.description: VALUES-018 has one active registry IR, an active-IR selector, and two historical candidate IRs with functional and semantic variants.
items.preservation: All variants are listed in traceability in authority order. The active selector explicitly marks both candidates historical_comparison_only.
items.resolution: Compile behavior from the active mathematical contract and active registry IR; retain historical candidates for comparison only.

items.description: The active contract and registry IR specify square-shape and closed-interval matrix validation, while wording in the optimized IR and oracle refers to explicit relation registration and endpoint-reference behavior.
items.preservation: The package implements only obligations common to or explicitly authoritative in the active contract and active registry IR, and records the divergent wording without importing historical evaluation semantics.
items.resolution: Active contract and active registry IR take precedence; optimized and oracle artifacts remain acceptance inputs subject to that authority.

items.description: Canonical types, domains, units, scales, operator signatures, formulas, solvers, comparison, aggregation, memory, integration, edge, endpoint, category, and evaluation semantics remain scientifically unresolved in the source artifacts.
items.preservation: Each package carries the exact feature-local unresolved identifiers and forbids scientific completion by the implementer.
items.resolution: Structural implementation is allowed; scientific execution requires future authoritative providers.

items.description: The authoritative Values inventory uses the count key expected_count, while the integration compatibility validator recognizes other established count aliases but not this one.
items.preservation: The domain catalog uses the exact authoritative inventory and count 14; the inventory is not rewritten on the domain branch.
items.resolution: Add expected_count as a generic compatibility alias in validator infrastructure on a separate integration-targeted change, following prior compatibility handling, without modifying Values science or the domain package branch.
